name: Bus Cap Berhad
overview: Bus Cap Berhad 于2026年5月在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。年内公司与 BYD Malaysia 签署谅解备忘录，计划在 Perak 设立电动巴士及相关辅助产品的本地组装与制造设施；并与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，涉及充电站基础设施、技术支持、半散件组装、销售、维护、安装及本地化等项目。
overview_en: Bus Cap Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in May 2026. During the year, the company signed an MOU with BYD Malaysia to pursue a Malaysia-based new energy commercial vehicle platform, including the proposed establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products;

segments.note_en: The company plans to explore, through an MOU, the establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Starcharge Energy 签署战略合作备忘录，合作涉及充电站基础设施、技术支持、半散件组装、销售、维护、安装及本地化等项目。
actions.text_en: Entered into a memorandum of strategic collaboration with Starcharge Energy involving charging station infrastructure, technical support and know-how, semi-knocked-down assembly, sales, maintenance, installation and localisation initiatives.

model_changes.text_en: Signed an MOU with BYD Malaysia to pursue a Malaysia-based new energy commercial vehicle platform, including the proposed establishment of a local assembly and manufacturing facility in Perak for electric buses and related ancillary products.
